questions.stem: According to the nebular hypothesis, what did the solar system form from?

options.text: The explosion of a single massive planet
A rotating cloud of gas and dust that collapsed under gravity
Material ejected from a black hole

questions.explanation: The nebular hypothesis states that the solar system formed from a large rotating cloud of gas and dust (a nebula) that collapsed under its own gravity. The centre formed the Sun, while the remaining material in the disc gradually clumped together to form the planets.
